verdict.rationale: Bolna ships an official MCP server that lets AI-native tools like Claude, Cursor, or Windsurf connect to a Bolna account and operate it (manage agents, calls, etc.) via natural-language commands, confirmed both in docs and via a live probe. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that the MCP integration works as described, and no additional natural-language control surfaces (e.g., chat-based dashboard) beyond MCP.
